options.text: Regroup the remainder $3$ ones as $30$ tenths, then divide $30$ tenths by $5$.
Stop at the ones place and ignore the remainder $3$.
After the tenths digit, any new remainder can be regrouped as hundredths to continue.
Write the remainder $3$ itself as the tenths digit of the quotient.

teacher.key_rationale: Remainder 3 ones regroup as 30 tenths for the next place; further remainders regroup as hundredths, and so on. Stopping ignores the remainder. Writing 3 as the tenths digit confuses remainder with quotient digit.

stem:
Tejas uses long division for $13 \div 5$. After the ones place he has remainder $3$ and wants to continue into decimals.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims correctly extend the division?
